faq.a1: Yes. Ansai adapts responses to your business tone: warm, formal, elegant or direct. You can always review and edit before publishing.
faq.q2: Can I edit responses before publishing?
faq.a2: Yes. That's the default behaviour. You receive a prepared response, review it, and can approve, edit or reject it with one click.
faq.q3: What about a very negative review?
faq.a3: Critical reviews are highlighted so you can review them with extra care. Ansai helps prepare a thoughtful response, but you stay in control before publishing.
faq.a4: Usually less than 10 minutes. You connect your profile, define your business tone and start receiving responses ready to review.
faq.a5: Ansai is designed to operate securely and in line with European GDPR. You can request export or deletion of your data whenever you need.
faq.a6: Yes. No commitments, no fine print. You can cancel anytime from your account.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Last updated: May 2026
terms.s1_body: Ansai is a SaaS platform that automates online review management for hospitality businesses. By registering and using Ansai, you agree to these terms in full.
terms.s2_body: Ansai is designed exclusively for legitimate professional use. You may not use it to post fake responses, manipulate reviews, send spam, or violate the terms of service of Google or other platforms. Violations may result in immediate account suspension.
terms.s3_body: Ansai generates response suggestions using artificial intelligence. You are solely responsible for reviewing, approving, and publishing each response. We do not guarantee specific results in ratings, Google rankings, or review volume.
terms.s4_body: We may update these terms occasionally. We will notify you by email at least 14 days in advance of any material changes. Continued use of the service after that date implies acceptance of the new terms.
terms.s5_body: For legal inquiries, contact us at yoel.capilla@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: May 2026
privacy.s1_body: We collect the data necessary to provide the service: account information (name and email), Google Business Profile data (reviews and linked public profile), service usage data, and payment data (processed by Stripe — we never store card details).
privacy.s2_body: We use your data exclusively to generate review responses, send service notifications, improve our algorithms, and comply with legal obligations. We never sell, rent, or share your data with third parties.
privacy.s3_body: We use essential session cookies and first-party analytics cookies without third-party tracking. You can manage your cookie preferences from your account settings at any time.
privacy.s4_body: As a user in the European Union, you have the right to access, correct, export, and delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights or file a complaint, contact us at yoel.capilla@gmail.com
privacy.s5_body: We keep your data while your account is active. Upon cancellation, we delete all your data within a maximum of 30 days, unless legally required to retain it for a longer period.
